description: This file is a Perl script intended to check and enforce certain style rules in Markdown documentation files within a Git repository. It scans files for proper formatting, specifically looking for lowercase usage after periods, with exceptions, and reports errors if violations are found.

methods.name: checkfile
methods.description: Reads a Markdown file, skips metadata sections, and checks for style inconsistencies related to lowercase usage after periods, reporting errors when rules are violated.
